description: NaV₃(PbO₃)₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.83 Å) Na-O bond lengths. V is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.74 Å) and one longer (1.77 Å) V-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.67 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Pb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one V and two equivalent Pb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one V and two equivalent Pb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Pb atom.
